description: Vietnamese L1 'đã-drop' transfer for REGULAR verbs: a past-time marker + a bare whitelisted regular verb gets the missing -ed (watch->watched, finish->finished, play->played, invite->invited). Complements the irregular rule (en-yesterday-irregular-beginner-past, buy/do/eat/go/have). Expectations encode the VERIFIED behaviour of correctWithTutorRules().
fp_risk_note: HIGH risk. Naive '-ed on a bare verb after a past marker' over-fires on: (1) habitual present with frequency adverbs ('Every day I cook', 'I always finish'); (2) future plans with bare present ('Tomorrow I invite...'); (3) verbs already in the past ('played' must not become 'playeded'); (4) irregulars that must not take -ed (handled by the irregular rule, not this one); (5) -y/-e spelling shifts. The v1 rule is whitelist-scoped, so a regular verb outside the whitelist ('cook' today) abstains. The negative cases lock surfaces (1)-(5), do-support questions, negated did, and the whitelist boundary.
